items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Run, Sinner run, somebody knocking at your door.

ctx.x: You got a crown, I got a crown, all God's children has crown. When we get to heaven, we're going to wear our crowns.

You got a crown? Oh God, children, I got a crown. When you get to heaven, you want to wear my crown. Shut all over, God, heaven. Oh, heaven. Shut all over, God, heaven. Heaven. Oh, heaven. Shut all over, God, heaven. Oh, that's all I'm saying. Oh, run. Sinner run, somebody knocking at your door. Run, Sinner run, somebody knocking at your door.
